# Theme Brief: Espresso & Ivory (`espresso-ivory` v1, theme #13)

Built 2026-10-15 from the designer's hand-off `bahja-final-wedding-themes-2026-10-13.zip` (theme
`espresso-and-ivory`). Code in `themes/espresso-ivory/v1/`. It shares its structure with Burgundy & Lace.

## Idea

- **Occasion:** Wedding.
- **Opening:** espresso textured paper with a fine double gold frame; an espresso envelope with an ivory
  bouquet and a gold botanical wax seal. The tap lifts the seal, opens the flap and raises an ivory card with the
  names, date and venue (about 2.5 s). The music starts with the tap.
- **Then:** espresso pages with ivory flowers, an ivory countdown, an arched calendar card, the reply card under
  the gold seal, guest messages and the date under the seal. Lines write themselves in from the reading side the
  first time they scroll into view (off with reduced motion).

## Owner decisions (chat, 2026-10-15)

- **No couple photo** for now: the photo and the lace ribbon behind it are removed; the ivory bouquet moved low
  beside the names.
- **Artwork and fonts are used as supplied.** The hand-off's `ASSET_NOTICES.md` records that the espresso paper,
  the ivory flowers and the ivory card shape come from a PrintServicesCo Etsy listing (personal use only); the
  fonts are the same as Burgundy & Lace. The owner chose not to replace them at this stage.

## Contract notes

- **Border:** the design's double gold rule. The platform draws the side rules (`assets/gold-rule.svg`,
  `strips`); with the theme's own border the theme adds the top and bottom rules.
- **Packages:** Normal / VIP / VVIP as the three `validStates`.
- **Kurdish:** Arabic until the owner approves Kurdish wording (`copy.ts`).
- **Print:** espresso card with the gold frame and the names on the ivory card shape; landscape back; A4 keepsake.
